title: Risk Assessment for Upper Urinary Tract Deterioration in Patients With Neurogenic Bladder: A Retrospective Study Using Interpretable Machine Learning Algorithms.
summary: A retrospective patient cohort evaluates machine-learning risk prediction for neurogenic-bladder deterioration. The conclusion is limited to the study cohort, reference standard and validation described in the paper.

organization: The Second Qilu Hospital of Shandong University
